::: {.profile-tagline}
ML Engineer · NLP Researcher · African Language AI
:::

I study machine learning systems for **low-resource African languages** — building tools that work for the speakers AI has largely left behind. My research spans machine translation, named entity recognition, gender bias in NLP, and explainable AI, with a focus on Luganda and Bantu language families.

I have contributed to foundational African NLP benchmarks — [MasakhaNER](https://direct.mit.edu/tacl/article-abstract/doi/10.1162/tacl_a_00416/107614) (TACL) and multilingual translation datasets spanning 15+ languages — and am actively seeking a **PhD position** to push this research further.
